Dear Candidate




"If your profile is shortlisted after the initial screening process, a member of the HR team will contact you to schedule the interview."




Job Description For Gen AI +Vertex AI:-




Your Role

Strong Python skills.
Experience with deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX).
Knowledge of NLP and ML.
Hands-on with GCP services: Vertex AI, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, BigQuery.
Practical experience with Generative AI models (Gemini, Vertex Search).
Familiarity with prompt design/tuning, vector stores, embeddings.
Ability to build endpoints using Flask/FastAPI.

Your Profile



Proven experience delivering AI solutions on Vertex AI.
Knowledge of Transformer models (BERT).
Professional ML Engineer certification preferred.
Problem-solving and analytical skills.



What youll love about working here



We recognise the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support in hybrid mode, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance
Our focus will be your career growth & professional development to support you in exploring the world of opportunities.
Equip yourself with valuable certifications & training programmes in the latest technologies such as Gen AI Vertex AI GCP Cloud.
